🎬 Tulsa King (2022–Present) — Crime, Drama, Comedy
After spending 25 years in prison, Dwight “The General” Manfredi is released expecting to return to the Mafia world he once knew. Instead, his former crime family sends him to Tulsa, Oklahoma, where he has no connections and almost no influence. Rather than accepting being pushed aside, Dwight decides to build an empire of his own.
Starting from almost nothing, Dwight surrounds himself with an unlikely group of allies and begins expanding his criminal operation. His old-school Mafia mentality clashes with the modern world, creating dangerous rivalries, unexpected partnerships, and plenty of moments of dark humor. But as his influence grows, so does the number of people who want to take him down.
Dwight also has to deal with the consequences of the life he chose. His loyalty, relationships, family, and ambition are constantly tested as he realizes that building a new life doesn't mean escaping the mistakes of his past.
More than just a gangster series, Tulsa King explores power, loyalty, second chances, identity, and what it means to start over when the world has already moved on without you. 🔥
💬 If you were Dwight, would you build your own empire or leave the criminal life behind? 👇
